The Filmmaker

Stories with vision.
Films with purpose.

Hello, I am Eskender Teklu, a passionate film director and scriptwriter dedicated to bringing powerful Ethiopian stories to life. My journey in filmmaking began at the Tom Videography and Photography Training Center, where I built a foundation in videography, photography, directing, scriptwriting, and editing. Following graduation, I moved into feature filmmaking and later pursued a Master's degree in Film Production at Addis Ababa University, graduating in July 2025. Today, I am focused on expanding my creative vision through international collaborations and projects that connect local narratives with worldwide audiences.

Director. Screenwriter. Producer. A filmmaker committed to ambitious storytelling, strong collaborations, and cinematic work that travels beyond borders.
